# Historical example fixtures

These signed, accessibility and deliberately failing PDFs were moved unchanged
from `examples/` on 2026-11-02. Their original manifests record the older creator
and validator versions, source inputs and known limitations. They are retained
for regression work, not presented as current passing examples.

`relocation.json` records original paths, current paths and SHA-256 hashes.
Paths inside the original manifests describe their historical locations.
The signing certificate is self-signed and for testing only; no private key is
included. No large PST conversion was run during this cleanup.

Current rebuilt examples are in [examples](../../../../examples/README.md).
